original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Thanks for coming in today. Before we start, can you confirm your date of birth for the chart?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Sure, it's 07/22/1991. And my new cell is (918) 555-0143 if the front desk needs it.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Got it. And the email on file, is that still right?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Yeah, maria.delacruz91@gmail.com. Oh, and billing asked me for my social again, 512-44-8193, I gave it to them at intake.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Okay. Last time we talked about the night shifts. How has this week been?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Honestly bad. I'm still the only Filipino charge nurse on nights at St. Brigid's Medical Center, so when two travelers called out on Saturday I covered the whole ER floor alone.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: That sounds exhausting. What happened in your body during that shift?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Around 3 a.m. my chest got tight, my hands went numb, I thought I was having a heart attack. That's the third panic attack this month.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: How are you sleeping between shifts?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Maybe four hours. I live alone now at 2417 Birchwood Lane, and the trains on the BNSF line wake me up constantly.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: You mentioned last session that your father's death was coming up on an anniversary.

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Yeah. My dad, Ernesto, died in the Moore tornado on May 20, 2025. He was helping a neighbor get into their storm shelter. It was on the news, they called him a hero on KOCO.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: That's a heavy loss, and a public one. How are you coping with it right now?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Mostly wine. Like four glasses most nights, sometimes the whole bottle on my days off.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: I want to ask directly, because it matters. Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to be alive?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Sometimes I wish I just wouldn't wake up. I don't have a plan or anything. I wouldn't do that to my brother Paolo, he already lost dad.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Thank you for telling me. Do you have access to anything at home you might use to hurt yourself?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: No guns. I do have meds from work, like I could get them easily, but I haven't thought about it like that.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Your PHQ-9 today came out at 17, which is in the moderately severe range. I'd like us to make a safety plan together and talk with Dr. Okafor about the sleep.

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Okay. Dr. Okafor at the Riverside clinic? My MRN there is 00483921 if you need it. My next shift is Thursday, can we meet Wednesday?

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Wednesday at 4 works. Call 988 or come to the ER if those thoughts get stronger before then.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Hey Jordan, good to see you. Your mom said you wanted to talk without her in the room today?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Yeah. Can you not tell her about the arm thing? She'll freak.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: We talked about confidentiality in the first session. If I'm worried about your safety I have to involve her, but we'd decide how together. What's going on with your arm?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: I've been cutting again. Just on my upper arm so the wrestling singlet covers it. Like three times since homecoming.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Thank you for being honest. What was happening before those times?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Mostly the group chat. Some guys on the team made a TikTok about me, my handle is @jordy_pins152 and they kept tagging me.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: That sounds humiliating. What did the video say?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: That I only won state because the other kid was sick. I won the 152-pound title at the 2025 Ohio state tournament, the first sophomore from Lakota East to do it, and now everyone acts like it doesn't count.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: So something you were proud of got turned into a target.

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Exactly. Coach Brennan just says ignore it. And my dad's deployed in Qatar until February so he can't really help.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: How are you sleeping and eating?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: I'm cutting weight anyway so I barely eat. Like one meal a day. Sleep's fine I guess.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Are you still taking the Vyvanse Dr. Patel prescribed for ADHD?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Yeah, 30 milligrams. It makes me not hungry which honestly helps with weight.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: I want to ask, have you had any thoughts of killing yourself?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: No. The cutting isn't like that. It just makes the noise stop.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Okay. If you ever need someone between sessions, you have my office number?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: I put it in my phone. Mine's five one three, five five five, zero one nine eight if you need to text me the time change.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: I'll keep using the portal. Next week, same time, Tuesday after practice. I'd also like to talk about bringing your mom in for part of it.

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Fine. But only part.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Mr. Halvorsen, thank you for coming in. How have the last two weeks been?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Quiet. Too quiet. Eleanor's been gone since September 3rd and the house on Superior Street doesn't feel like a house anymore.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: You were married a long time.

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Sixty-eight years. We ran the Lakeside Diner in Duluth for forty of them. People still stop me at the Cub Foods and ask about her pie.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: That's a lot of people who remember her. How old are you now, if you don't mind me asking for the form?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: I'm 93. Turned it in August. I'm one of maybe three Chosin Reservoir guys left in the whole Arrowhead region, the VFW post had a thing about it in the paper last year.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: How have you been sleeping?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: I wake up at 2 and I can't get back down. I sit in her chair. Sometimes I talk to her.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: That's very common in grief. Are you eating?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Toast. Coffee. My daughter Karen drives up from Minneapolis on Sundays and fills the freezer but I don't touch it.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: I need to ask you something important. Do you have any firearms in the house?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: My service pistol and a deer rifle in the closet. I'm not going to do anything stupid, if that's what you mean. But I won't lie, some nights I think I'd rather be with her.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: Thank you for telling me straight. Would you be willing to let Karen hold onto the pistol and rifle for a while?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Maybe. She's been after me about that. My VA claim number is 28 431 907 if you need to send anything to the VA.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: We can include that in the referral. I'm also noticing you've asked me the date twice today. Has your memory been different lately?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: I forget where I put the keys. Karen says I left the stove on last month. My hearing aids don't help much in this room either.

original.speaker: 치료자
original.text: I'd like to set up a memory screening with your primary doctor and see you again next week. Is Tuesday good?

original.speaker: 내담자
original.text: Tuesdays are fine. Every day is the same now.
